item.title: Federal, provincial, and territorial ministers responsible for emergency management discuss strengthening preparedness, resilience and interoperability
item.description: Today, federal, provincial, and territorial (FPT) ministers responsible for emergency management met in Edmonton to discuss lessons learned from recent emergencies, emerging risks faced by communities, and their priorities for strengthening future efforts of emergency management personnel, organizations and systems across Canada. Ministers discussed 2026 hazards and the significant impact of wildfires, floods and cold weather on critical infrastructure in communities across Canada. These impacts reinforce the importance of coordinated preparedness, effective response, and long-term recovery.

item.title: NEW TIME – Parliamentary Secretary Gasparro to highlight federal budget investments in Barrie
item.description: Members of the media are invited to join the Parliamentary Secretary to the Secretary of State for Combatting Crime, Vince Gasparro, on behalf of the Honourable Ruby Sahota, for an event in Barrie, Ontario, to highlight federal budget investments to build a stronger, more independent and resilient economy, and make life more affordable for Canadians.

item.title: Minister Anandasangaree highlights Government of Canada’s investments from Budget 2026: Masters of our destiny
item.description: In an increasingly turbulent world, Canada is determining its future. The federal Budget 2026 aims to make Canadians masters of their own destiny, build our sovereignty, and give us the freedom to live our lives as we choose. Being sovereign means building a country where Canadian culture thrives in all its diversity and creativity.

item.title: Federal, provincial, and territorial governments honour the recipients of the 2026-2027 Emergency Management Exemplary Service Awards
item.description: Today, the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, federal Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, along with the Honourable Robert Gauvin, New Brunswick’s Minister of Public Safety and Minister responsible for la Francophonie, honoured recipients of the 2026-2027 Emergency Management Exemplary Service Awards at a ceremony in Edmonton.
